The sorted output and non-mutation of input are both correct. Minor weaknesses include the absence of any legacy audit stage comments (the spec allows them and the staged checks would benefit from them), and the use of `setdefault` is slightly clever compared to an explicit if-not-in-buckets branch that would make the audit trail even more visible. The type annotation `dict[str, int | str]` is also slightly imprecise for the value dict. Overall this is a strong, readable, auditable implementation.
